summary_1line: Arjuna reveals himself, prepares for battle with divine weapons and banner, reassures the frightened Uttara, and sets out to face the Kaurava army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna strings the Gandiva and its thunderous twang shakes the earth as meteors fall and trees tremble.
A celestial banner bearing a roaring ape descends from the sky and rises upon Arjuna’s chariot as he prepares for battle.
Arjuna blows his mighty conch while Uttara collapses in fear on the chariot and the war horses kneel under the terrible sound.
